task.description:
Implement fix for ISS-0601-RECON-LEAK per src/design/reconstruction-leak-fix.md: (1) Duplicate ObjectMap keys in parseObjectMapFromJson and cloneJsonValue, (2) Implement freeObjectMap() helper, (3) Update freeJsonValue() to free object keys, (4) Replace test map.deinit() calls with freeObjectMap(). Target: eliminate 6,976 memory leaks in reconstruction.zig.

REWORK 1:
- [BLOCKER] Integration test test-integration-iss601 hangs during TC-ISS-601-08 reconstruction call. Build and unit tests pass. Debug the key duplication logic for performance issues or subtle bugs under heavy load (2500 events).

REWORK 3 (resumed after escalation, manual root-cause session):
- Root cause of the hang: transition() cloned InstanceState.variables/join_counters via the SHALLOW std.json.ObjectMap.clone(), which shares key/value memory with the source state. putVariableSafe's free-on-overwrite (added in rework 1/2) then freed memory still referenced by older generations, corrupting the GeneralPurposeAllocator's internal structures under high event volume (2500 events) and manifesting as a hang.
- Fix: added cloneObjectMapSafe()/cloneJsonValueSafe() to transition.zig to deep-clone variables/join_counters (and evaluateEdgeTransform's returned object) so every InstanceState generation fully owns its memory. Added freeInstanceState() to free a superseded generation's tokens/variables/join_counters/pending_task_nodes/error_detail in one call; reconstruction.zig's three replay loops now call it on each old_state instead of only deinit'ing variables/join_counters. Fixed a second, unrelated leak (join_counters growing without freeing prior entries on updateJoinCounter/clearJoinCounter) and several node_id-overwrite-without-free leaks in processNodeEntry/transition. Also fixed a latent, pre-existing bug surfaced during verification: reconstructInstancePointInTime's SQL queries lacked ORDER BY sequence_number, occasionally replaying events out of order and causing an unrelated flaky test failure.
acceptance_criteria: zig build test-integration-iss601 exits 0 with zero memory leaks in iss601_state_snapshots_test
All ObjectMap keys are duplicated before put()
freeJsonValue() updated to free object keys

result.summary: Resolved GH #409 (ISS-0601-RECON-LEAK): eliminated the 6,976 memory leaks and the TC-ISS-601-08 hang. Root cause was a shallow ObjectMap.clone() in transition() combined with putVariableSafe's free-on-overwrite, causing allocator corruption under high event volume. zig build, zig build test (86/86 steps, 583/667 tests, 84 legitimately skipped, 0 failed), and zig build test-integration-iss601 (8/9 tests passed, 1 skipped, 0 leaks) all pass cleanly and repeatably (verified across multiple clean-cache runs).
